title: Lakebase now supports PCI-DSS and HITRUST
body: Lakebase is now PCI-DSS and HITRUST compliant for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled. On AWS, this support is limited to the `us-east-1` region. On Azure, all regions where Lakebase is available are supported. See [Data protection](/aws/en/oltp/projects/data-protection).
